description: Decline an invitation to a pro ask: a link or the ask's number, with an optional `note` for the builder (up to 200 characters, only they read it). The builder hears it and can invite someone else; a link is used up. Taken until a report is sent. Previews; `confirm: true` declines, once the person says yes. Spends nothing.

confirm.description: false (the default) previews; true declines, once the person has said yes.

invitation.description: The invitation: its link (…/i/…), or the pro ask's number (my_invitations shows it).

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).

note.description: A line for the builder, in the person's words: only they read it. Optional.

name: decline_invitation
title: Decline an invitation to a pro ask
